say:1:1035145001:1.text: Around here? Are you referring to the ruins?
say:1:1035145001:1.source_cn: 附近？唔……你是指遗迹还是什么？

say:2:1035145002:0.text: Oh, I know. There have been quite a lot of Syndicate traders milling about lately.
say:2:1035145002:0.source_cn: 噢对了，说起来附近有很多商会的人。

say:3:1035145003:1.text: But the only thing of note are the ruins nearby... Could they be stealing precious artifacts and selling them?! No! That's unacceptable! It would damage the archaeological site!
say:3:1035145003:1.source_cn: 但这附近只有遗迹……难道他们在贩卖遗迹里搜刮出来的珍贵...
